none: PAS CAM-F96C95: Copper-alloy Nummus Roman Coin of Constantine II as Caesar
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NC ; R/ BEATA TRANQVILITAS

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine II as Caesar. Mint is London, 321, Reece period 16. Obverse shows Radiate, draped and cuirassed bust left. Obverse legend reads CONSTANTINVS IVN NC. Reverse shows Altar inscribed VOT/IS/XX, globe above; three stars. Reverse legend reads BEATA TRANQVILITAS. Reverse fields and exergue read: P/A//PLON. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 2.74g, diameter is 19.79mm.…
